pageQuotes.excerpt: Katapult — Investing in a thriving world for all Ecosystem Approach Impact Get in touch Katapult — Oslo, est. 2015 Accelerating system change for a thriving, regenerative world. We mobilise people, technology and capital, across an ecosystem of funds, accelerators, and platforms, towards a world where all humans thrive in harmony with nature. Explore the ecosystem Our approach Scroll Our story Katapult started in Oslo in 2015 as a single venture fund, founded by Tharald Nustad on a simple conviction: that the companies solving the world's hardest problems would also build the most valuable businesses of this century. A decade on, that single fund has grown into a family of organizations, each tackling a different piece of what it takes to move impact capital from the margins to the mainstream. We invest a systems lens at the intersection of technology and planetary resilience to accelerate the transformation towards a regenerative future. Impact to date A decade building the infrastructure for impact capital. 200 + Portfolio companies backed across our funds and accelerators. 50 + Countries represented by the founders we've invested in. 10 + Years operating at the frontier of impact investing.
